sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233137 + recreation.gov month availability 2026-08, 2026-09, 2027-06
Arapaho-Roosevelt NF campground status table (Canyon Lakes RD): Bellaire Lake 26 / 60' / Reserve Now / $30/60/111 / *$41/81/121 / May 15 - Sept 20

values.note: Single site $30 non-electric, $41 electric; double $60/$81, triple $121 (electric). One vehicle included; extra vehicles $8 a night. Includes use of the adjacent day-use area.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/bellaire-lake-campground ('Single Site: $30 per night (non-electric), $41 per night (electric)') + recreation.gov rates 2026-2028 Peak Season (STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30, STANDARD ELECTRIC 41) + recreation.gov notice 'EXTRA VEHICLE FEES ... $8.00 per vehicle per night', read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: RIDB catalog 233137: 21 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, all reservable and booked by the public (Reserved nights in Aug/Sept 2026), Electricity Hookup 50 on all 21; recreation.gov notice 'No RV water connections are available. Come with your RV/trailer water tank filled.', read 2026-10-26

sites.source: RIDB catalog 233137 (26 sites: 21 electric, 5 non-electric; Max Vehicle Length 30-60, 8 sites at 60) + FS status table '26 / 60''; FS page 'The parking length ranges from 30 to 75 feet', read 2026-10-26

values.note: Drinking water at hydrants only; filling RV tanks there is not allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233137 ('Flush toilets, vault toilets and drinking water are provided'; notice 'Filling at campground hydrants cross-contaminates the system and is not allowed') + FS page (Flush toilet(s); Potable water is available), read 2026-10-26

season.source: Arapaho-Roosevelt NF campground status table, Bellaire Lake 'May 15 - Sept 20' (FS page shows 'Site Closed' after the season), read 2026-10-26

values.note: A reserved site not occupied within 26 hours of the start of the reservation is released first-come, first-served.

booking.source: recreation.gov 233137 rules (reservationCutOff 4 day(s) prior to arrival), rates Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-19 (last bookable night), notice 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours of the beginning of the reservation'; FS status table 'Reserve Now', read 2026-10-26

note: Red Feather Lakes area, Arapaho-Roosevelt NF; an accessible boardwalk leads to 10-acre, no-wake Bellaire Lake. Little shade since beetle-killed trees were removed. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + RIDB + FS page/status table: confirmed 26 sites, 60 ft, 50-amp electric on 21 public sites, fees $30/$41; added water false (no RV water connections), flush+vault toilets, potable water, season May 15-Sept 20, 4-day booking cutoff, booking season.
